title: tridens muticus var. elongatus
intro: Tridens muticus var. elongatus, commonly known as the Long-Spike Tridens, is a type of grass found in tropical and subtropical regions. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues due to its reported health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of the Long-Spike Tridens include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and treat respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
